rows.title: A spouse as paid caregiver: Structured Family Caregiving only

values.program: CIH Waiver and Health & Wellness / TBI waivers (not a Family Supports Waiver service)
values.conditions: A spouse, or a parent of a minor, is a legally responsible individual and may be paid ONLY under Structured Family Caregiving: a per diem paid through a DDARS-approved provider agency, never directly, and only for extraordinary care beyond what the spouse would ordinarily provide. A spouse may NOT be paid under Attendant Care, Home and Community Assistance, Respite, or Participant-Directed Home Care. Claim notes must show the true spouse relationship. Under the service definition, Structured Family Caregiving is a caregiving arrangement in which the participant lives with the primary caregiver, who provides daily care and support to the participant in the private home of the participant or the caregiver.

rows.source: DDARS HCBS Waivers Provider Manual, Sections 9.30 and 11.28 (Structured Family Caregiving; legally responsible individuals)

rows.title: Paying a parent, stepparent, or legal guardian to care for their own minor child

values.conditions: Section 6.9 bars this because a parent, stepparent, or legal guardian is legally responsible for the minor's care: they may not receive payment for any waiver-funded service delivered to a waiver participant under 18, on either waiver. The bar is about minors only — a parent of an ADULT child may be paid as another relative, through a DDARS-approved provider agency.

rows.source: DDARS HCBS Waivers Provider Manual, Section 6.9

rows.title: Can a parent be paid to care for their own child on a waiver? It depends on the child's age

facts.label: Child under 18
facts.value: No — a parent, stepparent, or legal guardian may not be paid for any waiver-funded service to their own minor child (Family Supports or CIH)

facts.label: Adult child (18 or older)
facts.value: Yes — the parent is treated as another relative: paid only through a DDARS-approved provider agency, with the choice justified in the person's plan (PCISP); residential habilitation (PAC on Family Supports, RHS on CIH) is capped at 40 hours per week per caregiver

facts.label: A spouse is different
facts.value: a spouse may be paid only under Structured Family Caregiving

rows.source: DDARS HCBS Waivers Provider Manual, Section 6.9
